cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f3d.team: 154 - Fashion Place - Sur La Table, 6117 S State St #B139, Murray, UT 84107
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:f3d.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Store Floor Lead serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. · Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Support the achievement of store sales goals through effective customer engagement and team motivation. · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance · Direct employees to ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels and that the selling floor is adequately stocked and merchandised in accordance with visual standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Workweeks are expected to be between 20 and 25 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience · Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2095c6be-f1b2-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2095c6be-f1b2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Austria. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

You will create conversion-focused messaging across acquisition, onboarding, monetization, lifecycle marketing, and retention. Your work will help turn new users into engaged members, encourage upgrades, drive promotional revenue, and bring inactive users back. You will collaborate closely with product, growth, design, lifecycle, and performance marketing teams in a highly data-informed environment. The role combines strong creative craft with experimentation, requiring you to develop hypotheses, test messaging, analyze results, and continuously improve. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:dc1969ab-e197-494.description: THE OPPORTUNITY Companies have spent billions on AI tools and tokens. Almost none of them can prove it’s working. 95% of organizations report zero measurable return from their AI investments. Not because the tools are bad, but because nobody redesigned the workflows, coached the teams, or measured what actually changed. Modo is the AI success layer for the enterprise. We sit inside the flow of work, capture how teams actually use AI, guide them in the moment, and give leaders the ROI analytics to understand which AI tools and workflows are actually creating value. Today, Modo helps companies drive AI adoption and prove ROI inside real workflows. As we capture more workflow context, Modo becomes the layer understanding how work actually gets done across teams, tools, and AI, which allows companies to build proprietary custom agents grounded in their own workflows. We are a Seed stage startup, raised from One Way Ventures, Pear VC, Peterson Ventures, JFF Ventures, and a strong group of institutional investors and strategic operators. Now we need to build fast enough to match customer demand. THE ROLE This is not a typical engineering role. You’ll be our founding engineer, with an outsized role in how the product, company, and engineering culture evolve. You’ll write code, but you’ll also: - Talk to customers and join pilot calls - Turn feedback into product changes the same week - Influence the roadmap directly - Help close deals by building what matters fast - Own features end-to-end, from prototype to production In your first 90 days, you’ll: - Ship production code to real pilot customers in your first weeks - Build the core product surfaces: employee-facing guidance UX and manager dashboard - Work across the stack (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Postgres, Electron/Tauri) - Wire up LLM features that actually work in production, not just in a demo - Set up the telemetry and eval systems that make our insights credible In 6 months, you’ll: - Own large product surface areas end-to-end - Help convert pilots into paying contracts with your product work - Drive the reliability and quality bar that enterprise buyers expect - Start shaping engineering culture and hiring as we grow the team In 12 months, you’ll: - Architect key parts of the system - Be known by name to our biggest customers - Opportunity to lead engineering as we scale past our seed round Competitive salary, meaningful early equity, and the chance to grow into an engineering leadership role as we scale. WHO WE WANT - Shipping full-stack production-ready products in fast-moving environments - Strong with TypeScript, React, Next.js, backend APIs, and Postgres - Comfortable building across web and desktop (Electron, Tauri, or similar) - Has built LLM-powered features in production, not just prototyped with them - Production habits: CI/CD, testing, observability, pragmatic system design - Native with AI coding agents (Claude Code/Codex) - Obsessive about customer needs, not just abstract “users” - Comfortable debugging, writing tests, talking to customers, and jumping on a pilot call Bonus: Experience with building browser-based automation tools or developer/enterprise tools. THE TEAM You’ll join Johnny Chang https://www.linkedin.com/in/johnny-chang-519b11173/ (Stanford top AI agent research, taught most Stanford AI flagship courses with professors like Andrew Ng) and Angelina You https://www.linkedin.com/in/angelina-huilanyou/ (Meta data science, Stanford MS Eng, product growth at CircleCI) as the founding engineer. Product, engineering, and customer work all run through the same room. We’re backed by One Way Ventures, Pear VC, Peterson Ventures, JFF Ventures, and many more institutional funds and strategic angels. WHY MODO - Founding team member. Shape culture, product, and technology from the ground up. - Real ownership. Your code ships to enterprise customers from week one. - Leadership trajectory. Designed to grow into a leading engineering role. - In-person around SF. W

southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:13.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:13.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. WHO WE ARE Cognition is an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents. We are behind Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, an AI-native IDE. Our vision is AI that works alongside engineers as a genuine teammate, not a tool. We are a small, talent-dense team of competitive programmers, former founders, and researchers from Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Google DeepMind, and others. ROLE MISSION Infrastructure Engineers at Cognition build the systems that everything else runs on. Devin executes long-horizon tasks across sandboxed environments, spawns subagents, uses tools, and does all of this at scale across millions of sessions. Windsurf serves developers in real time with low-latency editor intelligence and agent-in-the-loop workflows. None of that works without world-class infrastructure underneath it. You will own the compute, orchestration, networking, and platform systems that make both products possible, and you will build them with the same engineering rigor and product instinct that the rest of the team brings to everything else. This is a role for engineers who care deeply about reliability, scale, and the craft of building systems that other engineers love to build on top of. WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH - Own agent execution infrastructure: Design and operate the sandboxed compute environments that power Devin's task execution, including VM orchestration, container management, resource scheduling, and isolation at scale. - Build and maintain the developer platform: Create the internal infrastructure that Cognition engineers depend on every day: CI/CD pipelines, deployment systems, developer tooling, and the abstractions that let product teams ship fast. - Drive reliability and observability: Define SLOs, build monitoring and alerting systems, lead incident response, and close the loop on postmortems so the same failure never happens twice. - Scale with the product: Anticipate capacity and architecture needs before they become bottlenecks; make deliberate infrastructure investments that stay ahead of product growth. - Partner across engineering: Work closely with product engineers and researchers to understand what the systems they are building require, and design infrastructure that meets those needs without creating unnecessary complexity. EXCEPTIONAL CANDIDATES HAVE DEMONSTRATED - Deep systems engineering: Experience designing and operating large-scale distributed infrastructure; strong opinions about reliability, failure modes, and operational excellence. - Cloud and container expertise: Hands-on proficiency with Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform. - Strong software engineering fundamentals: Infrastructure at Cognition means writing real code; proficiency in Python and comfort owning complex systems codebases. - Observability instincts: Knows how to instrument systems, build meaningful dashboards, and design alerts that surface signal without noise. - Security and isolation mindset: Experience with sandboxing, network isolation, and secure multi-tenant compute, particularly relevant for agentic workloads running arbitrary code. - Relevant industry experience: Prior experience at a frontier AI lab, applied AI company, or developer tools company; you know what good looks like in this category. - Degree from a top-tier university: BS, MS, or equiva

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:591e301b-2ae.description: Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries. At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Hebrew - Based in: Israel, Canada, France, Austria, Spain - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: 📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems 🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) 🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you. How to Apply? Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community. 📬Questions? If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.
